interface.name: denial_user_verifier_v1

description.summary: ask the user to prove who they are

interface.description:
A client asks Denial to show its own sheet for the session user's PIN or account password, as a phone does for an application that asks for the screen lock. Denial draws the sheet over everything and hands what the user typed to the asking client alone. Denial does not judge it: the client checks the credential with whatever it trusts and answers with accepted or rejected.
The sheet shows only on the session's unlocked desktop; while the session is locked, a pending verification waits. One verification shows at a time: a newer one, from any client, ends the older with cancelled.

entry.name: fingerprint
entry.summary: the client also verifies a fingerprint for this prompt

request.name: verify
request.description:
app names who asks, such as an application's name; title and description are what it asked with, and may be empty. credentials says what the client can check. The sheet offers the PIN when the client allows it and the user has one, else the password; the user may always switch to the password when the client allows it.
With fingerprint, the client runs a denial_fingerprint_verifier_v1 verification for the same prompt, and the sheet first offers only a button to the PIN or password beside the sensor Denial marks. It opens when the user taps it, or once a verification of this client ends without a match. A match does not close the sheet: the client destroys it.

interface.name: denial_user_verification_v1

description.summary: one sheet asking for a credential

interface.description: After cancelled the object is inert and the client destroys it. Destroying it closes the sheet.

request.name: accepted
request.description: The sheet closes. The client destroys the object.

request.name: rejected

description.summary: the credential did not prove the user

request.description: The sheet asks again, after retry_ms milliseconds when that is not zero.

event.name: credential
event.description: The sheet waits for accepted or rejected.

description.summary: the user closed the sheet, or a newer one replaced it
